text:
aina: quick pitch — avoid a broad runtime compat shim. build a tiny gateway shim that does 3 things only: header normalize, envelope unwrap/rewrap, and a couple of safe field aliases. much easier to test and retire.

sam: +1 on minimal surface. two concerns: 1) will aliases mask contract problems? 2) older SDKs that can’t add headers.

maria: telemetry plan: shim emits shim.used=true on traces, and increments mapped_field.{name}.drop and mapped_field.{name}.null counters. add a histogram transform_latency_ms. page if any mapped_field error_rate > 0.5% over 24h.

tom: perf note — lazy parse only when header present or tenant-flag. set transform budget 15ms and add circuit-breaker: if p99 transform_latency >20ms for 30s, bypass shim and emit shim.bypass_count.

aina: lifecycle proposal: 1) opt-in via header X-RI-Compat: 1 2) run shim for opt-ins only 3) after 30d of stable metrics, flip small opt-out cohort behind FF 4) retire shim ~90d after majority opt-out.

sam: SDK plan — ship tiny adapter snippets (2 lines) in each SDK repo + a curl example. console should offer tenant-level opt-in for customers who can’t change clients.

jen: communications — I’ll draft a one-pager migration playbook and email templates once we lock timelines. CS/marketing want dates and a rollback story.

deploy-bot: canary deployed gateway-compat v0.1 to prod-us-west (traffic 1%). logs: /infra/gateway/compat/2026-03-23/

aina: action items: sam -> SDK snippets; maria -> metrics + alert rules; tom -> cb + perf guard; jen -> playbook + comms. reconvene in 7 days to review canary metrics. :thumbsup:
